primitives.name: Public Surface Completion Law
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Finish or dark** — never "coming soon" on public surfaces.
primitives.assumptions: All public-facing URLs must resolve to either full functionality or 404; no placeholder states allowed.
primitives.breakdown_regime: S(T) = 0 for T < T_{launch} or T > T_{final}

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a binary decision tree with terminal nodes representing finality or absence of service.
layer2.telemetry: URL resolution status codes (404 vs 200) over time

primitives.name: Founder-Flip Settlement Gate
primitives.verbatim_quote: **LIVE_BOARD default off** — no public fires without founder flip + proof bar.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'B': 'Board state (0 = off, 1 = on)', 'F': 'Founder flip signal (boolean)', 'P': 'Proof barrier (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Public access to board data requires explicit founder authorization and validation of system integrity.

layer2.mapping: Derived from settlement kernel logic, where B is a derived function of F and P.
layer2.telemetry: Founder authentication logs and proof-of-integrity metrics

primitives.name: Product Integrity Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: **No affiliate / no paid contests / no prize pools**.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'A': 'Affiliate activity flag (0 = none, 1 = active)', 'C': 'Paid contest flag (0 = none, 1 = active)', 'P': 'Prize pool flag (0 = none, 1 = active)'}
primitives.assumptions: All revenue streams must be non-commercialized; no external incentives or monetized competition.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a constraint manifold in parameter space where A, C, P are constrained to zero.
layer2.telemetry: Revenue stream audit logs and contest type classification

These three laws together define a closed-loop system where each component must satisfy its own constraint before enabling downstream behavior. Failure modes include premature exposure of incomplete features, unauthorized board activation, or illicit monetization attempts.
